lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like distribution of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting increased inter-centroid spacing relative to the higher-density clusters on the cephalic region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal ridges to form a rectilinear pattern; circular clusters are localized within these grid intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel longitudinal features extending across the visible mid-to-upper flank, characterized by a distinct luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and lower intensity/shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent concave notch on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin, indicating localized tissue loss.
